title: 3 Questions a Godly Man Asks Before He Says Yes
caption:
Most yeses come from fear of letting someone down.

Ask whose voice you're answering, what the yes costs, and whether you can keep it. A clean no now beats a late one.

What's one yes you wish you'd taken back?

#faith #discipline #boundaries #godlymen #christianman #galatians1
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
